directory_policies.notes.10: Cost context: New on-campus MCS entrants become self-supporting in Fall 2027. The calculator currently stops at Summer 2027 entry; a Fall 2026 quote, Chicago price or online rate cannot establish the new cohort tuition. The full-program price remains pending.

fact_summary: The on-campus MCS changes new entrants to self-supporting status in Fall 2027. The official calculator currently offers entry terms only through Summer 2027; its Fall 2026 quote cannot establish the post-change cohort price.
